_comment: Single source of truth for the DuckStation oracle pin.
setup.sh (Windows) and duckstation_oracle.py (Linux/macOS) both read this,
so the two platforms can never drift onto different upstream bases.
The patch holds added lines only (see oracle_patch.py). Bump upstream_base only
together with a regenerated patch and re-made line_edits:
line_edits: upstream lines that are rewritten in place, by line number and hash.
